qa_method: Article-by-article review of the P2-002 internal Chinese EXPANSIONS against the official Arabic governing text, using the official English only as secondary guidance and the prior condensed Chinese candidate as the expansion baseline. Because P2-002 is an expansion track (the prior candidate existed but was condensed), each article is checked for: expansion faithfulness (added the compressed detail without changing meaning), semantic/material completeness against the Arabic (clause-segment parity and clause-by-clause coverage), terminology preservation/consistency, absence of hallucinated legal content, absence of missing legal effect, absence of over-expansion, source traceability (Arabic-source, English-guidance, prior-candidate and P2-backlog links/hashes), and official-status boundary (internal / non-official / non-binding / non-governing). Review only — no P2-002 Chinese text or remediation data was modified. Hashes/references only; no full Arabic/English/Chinese text embedded.
